title: Three witnesses held at gunpoint and given 'anthrax boosters'

tellings.quote: All three of these men directly after their encounters were given what they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters.

plain: Three men who had encounters with unexplained objects while in the US military were, right afterwards, held at gunpoint and given shots they were told were anthrax vaccine boosters. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells this, drawing on accounts linked to a man named Jonathan Wagant. If true, it would suggest the military treated such witnesses with something other than an ordinary vaccine.
